description.value:
You needle a foe with intimidation, provoking it to attack you. One creature you can see within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be compelled toward you for the duration, gaining disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you and needing to succeed on a Wisdom save each time it tries to move more than 30 feet away from you (a success lets it move freely that turn).

The power ends early if you attack another creature, cast a power targeting a different hostile creature, if an ally damages or harms the target with a power, or if you end your turn more than 30 feet from it. Droids and constructs are unaffected.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Dark Side Powers, Level 1
